tasks.title: Rain
tasks.description: Click on the green flag to start the rain simulation. A Raindrop sprite appears at a random position at the top of the stage and moves down.

requirements.title: A Raindrop sprite appears at a random position at the top of the stage
requirements.text: A Raindrop sprite appears at a random position at the top of the stage. Think which coordinate is constant there, and which one changes randomly?

requirements.title: The Raindrop sprite is moving down
requirements.text: Program the Raindrop sprite to move downward. What coordinate will change?

requirements.title: The Raindrop sprite falls until...
requirements.text: The Raindrop sprite falls until it touches the ground, i.e. the brown.

requirements.title: Repeat forever
requirements.text: Program the movement of the Raindrop sprite to repeat itself always

requirements.title: Program 2 more raindrops
requirements.text: Duplicate the code for the other raindrops. Use commands "hide" and "show" only for raindrops 2 and 3, and don't forget about command "wait__ seconds" for these two sprites, so that the drops fall at different times. Any amount of time can be used.

media.title: Rain
media.text: Start the project and watch the raindrops fall from random positions.

tasks.title: Goal
tasks.description: The Cat sprite always scores a goal! The Ball sprite always hits the goal, but each time it flies to a different point. Press the spacebar to run the Ball sprite.

requirements.title: Conversation with the Cat sprite

requirements.title: When you press the key, the Ball sprite goes toward the goal
requirements.text: When you press the spacebar, the Ball sprite returns to the starting point and then flies into the goal.

requirements.title: The Ball sprite flies to different points
requirements.text: We set the coordinate ranges using the "pick random __ to __" block. This time we need 2 commands. Study the dimensions of the goal.

tasks.title: Catch the ball
tasks.description: Drag the platform with your mouse. Program the Ball sprite so that when it collides with the platform, the sprite flies in different directions. Use only the commands available on the canvas.

requirements.title: Initial placement
requirements.text: Set the initial position of the Ball sprite.

requirements.title: The Ball sprite starts to move in random directions
requirements.text: The Ball sprite starts to move down, but not always in the direction of 180: sometimes it deflects either to the right or to the left. Program that movement using these commands.

requirements.title: Ball bouncing
requirements.text: The Ball sprite bounces off the platform, turning in a random direction away from the platform.

media.title: Catch the ball

tasks.title: Tennis
tasks.description: Use the left and right arrows to control the platform, hit the Ball sprite, and don't let it fly to the bottom edge! Look, after it's hit, the sprite rotates at different angles!

requirements.title: Controlling the platform
requirements.text: Program the platform controls.

requirements.title: The Ball sprite starts to move in random directions
requirements.text: The Ball sprite starts to move down, but not always in the direction of 180: sometimes it deflects either to the right or to the left. Program that movement using these commands.

requirements.title: Continuous movement of the Ball sprite
requirements.text: You're already familiar with this movement! Shall we program it?

requirements.title: Loss checking
requirements.text: Think about at what point the game ends. How is a loss indicated?

requirements.title: Ball bouncing
requirements.text: The Ball sprite bounces off the platform, turning in a random direction away from the platform.

requirements.title: *Bonus: add the ability to choose the difficulty level
requirements.text: The difficulty depends, for example, on the size of the platform. Make it so that you can choose the difficulty level.

requirements.title: *Bonus: add a second player
requirements.text: Redesign the game so that it can be played by two!

tasks.title: Rockfall
tasks.description: When you click on the green flag, all the sprites take their starting positions. The MarsBot is keyboard controlled. Rocks appear randomly at the top of the stage and move downward.

requirements.title: When you click on the green flag, all the sprites take their starting positions
Rocks appear randomly at the top of the stage and move downward
After touching the edge, the rock disappears and reappears at a random point at the top
It's a win if the MarsBot lasts 20 seconds
When the MarsBot and a rock touch, the loss event occurs

media.title: Rockfall
media.text: Use the arrow keys to move the MarsBot and dodge the falling rocks.
